verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS API service that also ships an official CLI and MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Stripe Tax or its tooling. The IP geolocation item describes tax-location input, not telemetry, so it is not relevant to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
